subject: Security review and log sample request — FjordHealth evaluation
messages:
From: Sofia Lind <sofia.lind@fjordhealth.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-04T15:12:00Z
Subject: Security review and log sample request — FjordHealth evaluation

Hi Lauren,

Hope you’re well. FjordHealth is evaluating Redwood for a critical logging + inference workflow and our security team would like to run a short technical review before we get to procurement. Attached is our SIG spreadsheet (FjordHealth_SIG_v1.xlsx) with a first-pass question set.

Two asks to start:
- Can we schedule a 60-minute call next week to walk the SIG/Qs and agree evidence owners?
- Can you provide a 7–30 day sample of request/response telemetry (redacted) and a short README that explains fields, timestamps, and retention period?

A couple of clarifying notes about the sample: we prefer examples that show token-level timestamps and any KV-cache metadata you capture. If there are PII concerns, please indicate whether you can provide anonymized samples or an indexed schema instead.

Availability on our side is fairly open Tuesday/Wednesday afternoons ET. Let me know what works.

Thanks — look forward to syncing.

—
Sofia Lind
Security Program Manager, FjordHealth
security@fjordhealth.com
Attachment: FjordHealth_SIG_v1.xlsx
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-04T17:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Security review and log sample request — FjordHealth evaluation

Hi Sofia — thanks for the SIG and context. We’re happy to run the review and can provide a sanitized log sample + a README that maps fields to our telemetry.

Proposed slots (ET):
- Tue 2026-10-06 14:00–15:00 ET
- Wed 2026-10-07 15:30–16:30 ET

Pre-call we’ll prepare:
- a short README (redwood-log-sample-README.md) describing columns/timestamps and redaction approach
- a 7-day sampled export (anonymized) showing request/response headers, token counts, and kv-cache markers
- status on SOC 2 scope and CAIQ/answers for the highest-weighted SIG rows you flagged

Marissa (CC’d) will run the call and own the evidence handoff; Irene will cover telemetry/ops questions. If you can flag which SIG sections you want prioritized (e.g., network controls, logging & retention, access controls) we’ll tailor the pre-read.

I’ll attach the README in a follow-up email and send calendar invites once a slot is confirmed.

Best,
Lauren
Security & Compliance Partner, Redwood Inference
Attachment (will follow): redwood-log-sample-README.md

We’ll meet: 2026-10-06 14:00–15:00 ET. Calendar invite sent (link: https://cal.example.com/meeting/3b2a).

Meeting agenda (high level):
1) Introductions & scope (10m)
2) SIG walkthrough — priority rows (20m)
3) Log sample and README review (20m)
4) Action items & evidence delivery timeline (10m)

Pre-call deliverables (we will upload these to the Drive link before the meeting):

- 7-day anonymized telemetry sample (S3/Drive link during call) — owner: Ops Eng team (Irene will surface during session)

Runbook notes attached for reference: runbook-meeting-notes.pdf (short checklist for evidence exchange). Please reply if you want a longer retention window or a tenant-specific sample — we can accommodate with an NDA if required.

Next steps:
- Sofia: reply to confirm if priority SIG rows include Logging & Monitoring (A), Data Protection (B) and Network Controls (C)
- Redwood: push pre-read materials to Drive by EOD 2026-10-05 PT

Thanks — looking forward to the call.

Marissa / Lauren — thanks and confirmed for 2026-10-06 14:00 ET.

Quick clarifications before the call:
- PII: we require assurance that the sample will have all patient identifiers removed/hashed. If you can outline the redaction steps in the README that will be helpful.
- Tenant-specific samples: does Redwood have a way to provide a sample export scoped to a single customer tenant rather than aggregated telemetry? If yes, please note any approval steps.
- Retention: prefer a 30-day window but a 7-day sample is ok for the call.

Thanks — I’ll mark Logging & Monitoring (A) and Data Protection (B) as top priority in the SIG sheet.

Thanks Sofia — appreciate the priorities. Short follow-up and next steps before the call:

Pre-call deliverables (to be uploaded to Drive by EOD PT):
- redwood-log-sample-README.md — details on redaction pipeline and field mapping (Irene)
- 7-day anonymized telemetry sample (S3 link will be shared during the call) — Ops (Irene)
- CAIQ/SOC2 summary for flagged SIG rows (Marissa)

Answers to your clarifications:
- PII redaction: we will remove direct identifiers, hash any unique IDs, and redact free-text fields where necessary. The README will list which fields are redacted and the hashing method.
- Tenant-scoped sample: yes, we can produce a tenant-scoped export. For non-production tenant snapshots we require a short intake form and a signed DPA addendum; we can start that workflow after the call.
- Retention window: we’ll prepare a 7-day sample for the call and note how to generate a 30-day export if you want one after the meeting.

Action items after the call (high level):
- Marissa: provide SOC 2/CAIQ control mapping within 3 business days
- Irene: provide tenant-scoped sample intake template & S3 link delivery during call
- Sofia: confirm any NDA/DPA requirements for tenant-scoped samples

If anything else comes up before the call reply-all and we’ll adjust. See you Tuesday.

Best,
Lauren
Security & Compliance Partner, Redwood Inference
